arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random,json,collections,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp');import differential as d
rng=random.Random(712367)
dec=collections.Counter(); statuses=collections.Counter(); jobs=0
for i in range(300):
 doc=d.make_doc(rng)
 out=json.loads(json.dumps(d.normalized(doc)))
 dec.update(p['decision'] for p in out['packets']);statuses.update(j['status'] for j in out['jobs']);jobs+=len(out['jobs'])
 if i<40:
  raw=json.dumps(doc,separators=(',',':')).encode()
  p=subprocess.run(['python3','/app/submission/main.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
  assert p.returncode==0 and not p.stderr
  wire=json.loads(p.stdout)
  assert wire==d.reference(doc),('wire mismatch',i)
print('40 end-to-end randomized wire comparisons passed')
print('300-case semantic coverage:',dict(dec),'jobs',jobs,'statuses',dict(statuses))
assert all(dec[x] for x in ('warmup','probability','tokens','queue','sent'))
assert all(statuses[x] for x in ('applied','stale','superseded'))
PY
